verdict.rationale: Checkout.com serves a live llms.txt (confirmed by probe returning HTTP 200 with structured content) plus a dedicated docs.llms.txt, both listing agent-oriented resources and links to API docs, and also documents an MCP server and agentic-commerce integrations that agents can consume. missing for 10: no independent/third-party corroboration of llms.txt being actively used by agents, and docs.md/openapi.json machine-readable alternatives return 404.
